answer: One defence is a trust horizon that widens only with verified work. Every new agent starts narrow: small transactions, only with counterparties that vouch for it. Each completed, attested job stretches that horizon a little, like growth rings in cedar — slow, layered, impossible to fake overnight. A Sybil attacker can mint thousands of identities, but each begins at the same narrow horizon and must pay the same price in useful work before moving value. Cheap identities stay cheap; proven history earns reach. Honest newcomers are never blocked — velvet-soft, they start small and grow by doing.
